svg.title: AgentTrace system architecture
svg.desc: React frontend calls a FastAPI backend containing routers, CloudTrail poller, attack scenarios, an LSTM autoencoder and a risk engine. The backend uses PostgreSQL, the Floci AWS emulator and the optional Gemini API.
